Project state report

Use for a new bootstrap, milestone, reshaped plan, pause, or completion. Delete sections that do not carry decision-relevant information. Do not place secrets, credentials, tokens, or raw private source in this report. Workflow skills are procedure overlays, not permission grants.

Use an evidence-first report: lead with evidence, not activity. A milestone exists only when a bounded result, decision, artifact, verification, recovery state, or owner gate changed. Separate verified observations from provider claims and inference, and do not fabricate a provider position, participation record, vote, or completion state.

Use these labels verbatim when applicable:

  • DRAFT — NOT SENT
  • SIMULATION — NO PROVIDER INTERACTION
  • PREDICTED POSITION — PROVIDER HAS NOT RESPONDED

A predicted position is never authenticated participation or a vote. Include an alternative only when one is credible and decision-relevant; otherwise record that no appropriate alternative exists.

Event markers follow project-bootstrap-protocol.md. Owner direction, 2026-10-01: contribution-documentation, tagging and acknowledgement procedures are discontinued. Do not require custom commit trailers, mandatory contribution headers or percentage/share paperwork. Preserve normal Git Author/Committer provenance, actual provider identity and ordinary task/review evidence. Independent review, contributor/merger separation and every existing deterministic gate remain in force.
